mapper.select: SELECT g.game_id AS "gameId", g.game_name AS "gameName", r.image_key AS "representativeImageKey", (r.image_key IS NOT NULL AND i.image_key IS NULL) AS "representativeImageDangling" FROM public.games g LEFT JOIN public.image_relations r ON r.game_id = g.game_id AND r.source_type = 'GAME' AND r.source_parent_key = '' AND r.source_key = g.game_id LEFT JOIN public.images i ON i.game_id = r.game_id AND i.image_key = r.image_key ORDER BY g.game_id
